title: {medication_name} {time} Reminder
cron: [set per medication schedule, e.g., '0 8 * * *' for 8am daily]
message: Time for {care_recipient}'s {medication_name} {dose}. Reply DONE when taken ✅
escalate_message: {care_recipient}'s {medication_name} {dose} was due at {time} but hasn't been confirmed. Please check.
_note: One of these is created per medication per time slot. A patient on 3 meds at 8am and 2 meds at 8pm gets 5 reminder schedules.
